description: Daily sleep snapshot: one night's duration and quality rating from a wearable (health v2.5)
notes: health:sleepQuality is written as an IRI (health:Good) because that is what every known emitter produces, even though health.ttl still declares the property xsd:string-ranged. health:DailySleepSnapshotShape asserts no sh:datatype for exactly that reason and constrains the permitted individuals instead.
